body.note: GC500 Demob week 3 · work 9-13 Nov 2026 (and 3 Nov, missed from week 2) · Advanced's invoice-totals sheet dated 17/11/2026 $8,800.00: loading/unloading at the Advanced compound 68.0 h $6,800.00 (signed 24008 62.0 h; 24006 Tue 3 Nov 6.0 h), team leader 2 a day x 5 days $2,000.00 (no signed paper, billed as every week) · approved as invoiced by Andrew Fisher 19 Nov 2026 · receipt and payment not yet recorded

source.author: Andrew Fisher
source.sheet: GC500 - COATES HIRE - FENCING INSTALLATION PROGRAMME (DECON WK3) - INV TOTALS
notes: 24008: the sheet bills it on five rows, PW3 Mon 9 Nov 11.00 h, Tue 10 Nov 9.50 h, Wed 11.50 h, Thu 12 Nov 21.00 h (x 2-men), Fri 13 Nov 9.00 h, 62.0 h, as 'Phillip Park - Loading/Unloading Duties'; the signed service note (Advanced Compound, 9-13 Nov) carries the same days and hours, Thu 10.5 h + Daniel 10.5 h (Advanced's man, Andrew 13 Nov). Recorded under its first day, 9 Nov.

24006: the sheet bills PW2 Tue 3 Nov 6.00 h, 'Time sheet missed from PW2'; the signed service note (Advanced Compound, 2-6 Nov) carries Tue 6 h, starred 'Added to Decon Wk3'. The week 2 sheet (PO 4647525) billed 2, 4, 5 and 6 Nov only, so 3 Nov is billed once. 24006 is recorded under its first day, 2 Nov; the 6.0 h allocated here are its 3 Nov hours.

Team leader: the sheet bills 2.0 a day on each of its PW3 rows, Mon 9 - Fri 13 Nov (2 a day x 5 days x $200 = $2,000.00); no signed paper carries it; billed and paid the same way as the construction weeks and demob week 1. Approved by Andrew Fisher 19 Nov 2026.
All hours at the standard $100.00/h; nothing at the $142.00 rate. No hire agreements, metres, removals or gates on this sheet.
The sheet adds to $8,800.00 (labour 68.00 h x $100 = $6,800.00; team leader 10 x $200 = $2,000.00); approved as invoiced by Andrew Fisher 19 Nov 2026 ('approved').
source.tax_basis_note: Allocated as ex GST under the project convention in AGENTS.md, as the construction weeks' sheets.
source.invoice_status: Supplier invoice number and tax invoice not supplied. Approved by Andrew Fisher at $8,800.00 on 19 Nov 2026; no receipt or payment is asserted.
